BusinessContext.Description: Converts SWIFT MT950 (Statement Message) to ISO 20022 camt.053.001.08 (BankToCustomerStatement). MT950 is the interbank/nostro-vostro variant of the customer statement, sent between correspondent banks (unlike MT940 which is sent to the account-owning customer). Structurally near-identical to MT940 but does not carry field :86: (Information to Account Owner) — MT950 is a simplified statement intended for bank-to-bank reconciliation rather than customer-facing detail.

UseCases.UseCase: Nostro/Vostro account statement reconciliation between correspondent banks
Treasury liquidity monitoring across correspondent accounts

BusinessContext.ApplicableDomains: Correspondent Banking, Treasury Operations, Nostro Reconciliation, Cash Management

TechnicalSpecifications.KeyDifference: MT950 has no field :86: (no free-text remittance detail per entry) — this is the main structural difference from MT940. Statement lines (:61:) are present but their corresponding camt.053 entries carry no RmtInf/Ustrd content, since MT950 is a summary interbank statement rather than a customer-facing detailed one.

ComplianceRequirements.Regulation: SOX — Financial Controls and Statement Accuracy

Variable.name: MAX_REF_LENGTH
Variable.description: Maximum length of MT950 reference fields

Variable.name: OPENING_BALANCE_CODE
Variable.description: ISO 20022 balance type code for opening balance

Variable.name: CLOSING_BALANCE_CODE
Variable.description: ISO 20022 balance type code for closing balance

Variable.name: DEFAULT_TX_CODE
Variable.description: Default SWIFT transaction type code when not specified in field :61:

SourceMessage.MessagePurpose: Interbank statement sent between correspondent banks for nostro/vostro account reconciliation. Structurally similar to MT940 but without field :86: — intended for bank-to-bank reconciliation, not customer delivery.

Field.Description: Unique reference of the statement message
Identification of the nostro/vostro account being reported
Sequential statement number and optional page sequence
Debit/credit mark, date, currency and amount of opening balance
Individual interbank transaction entry — value date, entry date, D/C mark, amount, transaction type, reference
Debit/credit mark, date, currency and amount of closing balance
Funds available for immediate use, distinct from closing book balance

Field.ExampleValue: Entry with Amt, CdtDbtInd, ValDt, BookgDt — no RmtInf (MT950 has no :86:)

General.BusinessRationale: Reference identifies both the overall message and the statement itself — identical pattern to MT940
General.AuditRequirement: Statement reference logged for interbank reconciliation audit trail.
General.ComplianceRequirement: MsgId and Stmt/Id mandatory per camt.053 schema.
General.MigrationNote: MT950 field :20: fits within camt.053 Max35Text without truncation. Same logic as MT940 MAPPING_01.

General.BusinessRationale: Mandatory camt.053 header field. No MT950 equivalent.
General.AuditRequirement: Conversion timestamp logged for SLA monitoring.
General.MigrationNote: Generated at conversion time, always UTC. Same as MT940 MAPPING_02.

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: account_string = trim(MT.F25) if(isIBAN(account_string)) Acct.Id.IBAN = account_string if(!isIBAN(account_string)) Acct.Id.Othr.Id = account_string

General.ImpactIfFails: Statement for wrong nostro/vostro account — interbank reconciliation failure
General.BusinessRationale: Account identification is mandatory for correspondent banking reconciliation
General.AuditRequirement: Account ID logged. Retention: AUDIT_RETENTION_YEARS years.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Account identification required per correspondent banking agreements and banking secrecy laws.
General.DataPrivacy: IBAN is financial PII. Must be masked in logs per GDPR Article 25.
General.MigrationNote: MT950 field :25: format identical to MT940. Same isIBAN() dispatch logic applies.

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: field_28c = trim(MT.F28C) if(contains(field_28c, "/")) stmt_num_str = substring_before(field_28c, "/") if(!contains(field_28c, "/")) stmt_num_str = field_28c Stmt.ElctrncSeqNb = to_integer(stmt_num_str)

General.ImpactIfFails: Statement sequence tracking broken — duplicate/missing statement detection fails between correspondent banks
General.BusinessRationale: Statement number enables correspondent banks to detect missing statements in sequence
General.AuditRequirement: Statement sequence logged for gap detection.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Sequential statement numbering required for audit trail completeness.
General.MigrationNote: MT950 field :28C: format identical to MT940 — NNNNN/NN, only statement number component maps to ElctrncSeqNb (integer).

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: dc_mark = substring(MT.F60F, 1, 1) date_str = substring(MT.F60F, 2, 6) currency = substring(MT.F60F, 8, 3) amount_str = substring(MT.F60F, 11) Bal_OPBD.Tp.CdOrPrtry.Cd = OPENING_BALANCE_CODE Bal_OPBD.Amt = decimal(amount_str.replace(",",".")) Bal_OPBD.CdtDbtInd = (dc_mark == "C") ? "CRDT" : "DBIT" Bal_OPBD.Dt.Dt = expandCentury(date_str, "yyMMdd", CENTURY_CUTOFF_YEAR)

General.ImpactIfFails: Interbank statement balance incorrect — nostro/vostro accounting discrepancy
General.BusinessRationale: Opening balance is the starting reference point for interbank statement period reconciliation
General.AuditRequirement: Balance amounts logged for SOX financial controls.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Accurate opening balance mandatory for correspondent banking statement completeness.
General.MigrationNote: Identical parsing logic to MT940 MAPPING_05 — same SWIFT balance composite format.

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: Ntry.Amt = decimal(MT.F61.amount) Ntry.CdtDbtInd = (MT.F61.dcmark == "C" OR MT.F61.dcmark == "R") ? "CRDT" : "DBIT" Ntry.ValDt.Dt = expandCentury(MT.F61.date, "yyMMdd", CENTURY_CUTOFF_YEAR)

Condition.Action: DO NOT populate RmtInf/Ustrd — MT950 carries no field :86:, unlike MT940

General.ImpactIfFails: Individual interbank transaction line missing or incorrect in statement
General.BusinessRationale: Statement line parses to individual entry for interbank reconciliation — same complex composite as MT940 :61:
General.AuditRequirement: Each entry logged for transaction-level audit trail.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Complete transaction detail required for statement accuracy per SOX.
General.DataPrivacy: Transaction data may reference counterparties — treat as sensitive.
General.MigrationNote: KEY DIFFERENCE from MT940: no corresponding :86: field exists in MT950, so the resulting camt.053 Ntry has no NtryDtls/TxDtls/RmtInf/Ustrd content — the entry carries only the core :61: data (amount, date, indicator).

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: dc_mark = substring(MT.F62F, 1, 1) date_str = substring(MT.F62F, 2, 6) currency = substring(MT.F62F, 8, 3) amount_str = substring(MT.F62F, 11) Bal_CLBD.Tp.CdOrPrtry.Cd = CLOSING_BALANCE_CODE Bal_CLBD.Amt = decimal(amount_str.replace(",",".")) Bal_CLBD.CdtDbtInd = (dc_mark == "C") ? "CRDT" : "DBIT" Bal_CLBD.Dt.Dt = expandCentury(date_str, "yyMMdd", CENTURY_CUTOFF_YEAR)

Condition.ElseAction: LOG_WARNING "Balance continuity check failed" AND PROCEED

General.ImpactIfFails: Interbank statement closing balance incorrect — nostro/vostro accounting discrepancy, completeness verification fails
General.BusinessRationale: Closing balance mandatory for interbank statement completeness verification, final balance for the period
General.AuditRequirement: Closing balance and continuity check result logged for SOX financial controls.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Closing balance mandatory for correspondent banking statement reporting.
General.MigrationNote: Same parsing logic as opening balance (MAPPING_05) but uses CLBD code. Identical to MT940 MAPPING_08.

Condition.Action: PROCESS if present, skip if null — field :64: is optional in MT950

General.ImpactIfFails: Available balance information missing — statement still valid since field is optional
General.BusinessRationale: Closing available balance distinguishes funds available for immediate use from closing book balance — important for correspondent bank liquidity management
General.PerformanceImpact: LOW (string parsing, same as other balance fields)
General.AuditRequirement: Available balance logged alongside closing balance for cash position audit trail.
General.ComplianceRequirement: No specific regulatory mandate — best practice for Basel III intraday liquidity monitoring (BCBS 248).
General.MigrationNote: Same parsing logic as MT940's equivalent field :64: mapping — optional, uses CLAV code.
